hero.title: Different Scale, Different Future
hero.sub: What happened when three people set out to prove that a company can grow without growing at any cost. The Impact Journey Report 2021-2023, in seven stops.

paragraphs: We founded Zebras and Company in March 2021 to back zebra companies: businesses that pursue social and economic goals together, over long horizons, in mutual benefit with their communities. Three years on, we wrote this report not as a typical impact report but as a letter from us, who are just a little further down the road, a kind of travel diary of what we have learned by walking alongside zebra companies.

This site takes the report's argument and turns it around. Proof first, definition second, the money, three cases, the criticism we still cannot fully answer, why the idea took root here, and then a pen for you. The report summarizes our activities up to fiscal year 2023.
